resultsProcessor.script: function call(request) { var response = context.sendToStep('accept-key-store', JSON.stringify(request)); if (response.isErrored()) throw new Error(response.getAllErrors()[0]); return JSON.parse(response.getBody()); } var generated = call({ getOrGenerate: { keyId: 'service/generated', purpose: 'sign' } }); if (generated.keyId !== 'service/generated' || generated.purpose !== 'sign' || generated.created !== true || generated.keyPair.secretKeyHex === undefined) throw new Error('expected generated immutable key pair'); var repeated = call({ getOrGenerate: { keyId: 'service/generated', purpose: 'sign' } }); if (repeated.created !== false || repeated.keyPair.secretKeyHex !== generated.keyPair.secretKeyHex) throw new Error('expected existing generated key pair'); var invalid = context.sendToStep('accept-key-store', JSON.stringify({ put: { keyId: 'service/generated', value: 'AQ==' } })); if (!invalid.isErrored()) throw new Error('expected immutable put rejection'); context.sendMetric('key-store-cross-deployment-pass', 1.0);
